// Test tables and transforms derived from grafana/tempo:
// https://github.com/grafana/tempo/tree/1a7373ee774b2ee5a40957c2310179b0ef7ff843
// pkg/traceql/engine_metrics_test.go:1044-1707 (all 87 TestScalarMath rows)
// tempodb/tempodb_metrics_test.go:1289-2644 (all 23 math_ rows)
// pkg/traceql/parse_test.go:1966-2179 (18 positive / 6 negative rows)
// See the adjacent LICENSE; copied data/closures are not relicensed under MIT.
//
// Reproduce the entire metrics-math.json from the Pulse repository root:
//
//	tmp=$(mktemp -d)
//	cp test/fixtures/traces/tempo_integration/metrics-math-producer.go.txt "$tmp/main.go"
//	GOWORK=off GO111MODULE=off go run "$tmp/main.go" > "$tmp/metrics-math.json"
//	cmp "$tmp/metrics-math.json" test/fixtures/traces/tempo_integration/metrics-math.json
//	rm -rf "$tmp"
//
// Validated with Go 1.25.10; stdlib only, no network or Tempo/Pulse imports.
// Executing test transforms is NOT executing Tempo's engine.
//
// Extraction: Go parser AST selected every element of TestScalarMath's range
// table, every queryRangeTestCases element whose name starts with math_, and
// the two grammar tables. Scalar q/noOp/table expressions are copied unchanged.
// Storage numeric expressions, labels and sample order are copied unchanged;
// only protobuf type/helper names become local data-only stand-ins. No runtime
// implementation was copied. fixtureMetadata holds source SHA-256s, inclusive
// per-case source line hashes, grammar input/expected-AST text and exact inputs.
// The range hashes are over whole source lines including trailing LF.
//
// Scalar arrays retain NaN holes (before ToProto); storage L3 arrays are the
// upstream sparse final outputs (after ToProto). Do not mix these conventions.
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"os"
)

type label struct {
	Name  string `json:"name"`
	Type  string `json:"type"`
	Value string `json:"value"`
}
type sample struct {
	TimestampMs int64   `json:"timestamp_ms"`
	Value       float64 `json:"value"`
}
type series struct {
	Labels  []label  `json:"labels"`
	Samples []sample `json:"samples"`
}
type storageCase struct {
	name, query                        string
	expectedL1, expectedL2, expectedL3 []*series
}

func stringLabel(name, value string) label { return label{Name: name, Type: "string", Value: value} }
func number(v float64) any {
	if math.IsNaN(v) {
		return "NaN"
	}
	if math.IsInf(v, 1) {
		return "+Inf"
	}
	if math.IsInf(v, -1) {
		return "-Inf"
	}
	if v == 0 && math.Signbit(v) {
		return json.Number("-0.0")
	}
	return v
}

func scalarTable() []struct {
	name      string
	q         string
	transform func(float64) float64
} {
	q := "{ } | count_over_time() by (span.foo)"
	noOp := func(v float64) float64 { return v }
	return []struct {
		name      string
		q         string
		transform func(v float64) float64
	}{
		{
			name:      "A",
			q:         q,
			transform: noOp,
		},
		// basic
		{
			name:      "A + 10",

			name:      "5 - A",

		{
			name:      "A * 2",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("(%s) * 2", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return v * 2 },
		},
		{
			name:      "2 * A",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("2 * (%s)", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return 2 * v },
		},
		{
			name:      "A / 2",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("(%s) / 2", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return v / 2 },
		},
		{
			name: "2 / A",
			q:    fmt.Sprintf("2 / (%s)", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 {
				if v == 0 {
					return math.NaN()
				}
				return 2 / v

		},

		// float
		{
			name:      "A + 1.5",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("(%s) + 1.5", q),

			name:      "1.5 + A",

		{
			name:      "A - 1.5",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("(%s) - 1.5", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return v - 1.5 },
		},
		{
			name:      "1.5 - A",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("1.5 - (%s)", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return 1.5 - v },
		},
		{
			name:      "A * 2.5",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("(%s) * 2.5", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return v * 2.5 },
		},
		{
			name:      "2.5 * A",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("2.5 * (%s)", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return 2.5 * v },
		},
		{
			name:      "A / 2.5",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("(%s) / 2.5", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return v / 2.5 },
		},
		{
			name: "2.5 / A",
			q:    fmt.Sprintf("2.5 / (%s)", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 {
				if v == 0 {
					return math.NaN()
				}
				return 2.5 / v
			},
		},
		{
			name:      "A + 1e6",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("(%s) + 1e6", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return v + 1e6 },
		},
		{
			name:      "A + 1e31",

		// edge cases
		{
			name:      "A / 1",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("(%s) / 1", q),
			transform: noOp,
		},
		{
			name: "1 / A",
			q:    fmt.Sprintf("1 / (%s)", q),

			q:         fmt.Sprintf("0 * (%s)", q),

			q:         fmt.Sprintf("(%s) / 0", q),
			transform: func(float64) float64 { return math.NaN() },

			name: "0 / A",
			q:    fmt.Sprintf("0 / (%s)", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 {
				if v == 0 {
					return math.NaN()
				}
				return 0
			},
		},
		{
			name:      "A + 0",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("(%s) + 0", q),
			transform: noOp,
		},
		{
			name:      "0 + A",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("0 + (%s)", q),
			transform: noOp,
		},
		{
			name:      "A - 0",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("(%s) - 0", q),
			transform: noOp,
		},
		{
			name:      "0 - A",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("0 - (%s)", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return -v },
		},
		{
			name:      "A + ( 1.0 / 0)",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("(%s) + (1.0/0)", q),
			transform: func(float64) float64 { return math.Inf(+1) },
		},

		// int vs float
		{
			name:      "A * 3/2 (int)",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("(%s) * ( 3 / 2 )", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return v },
		},
		{
			name:      "A * 3.0/2 (float)",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("(%s) * ( 3.0 / 2 )", q),

		// negative numbers (int)
		{
			name:      "A + -10",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("(%s) + -10", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return v + -10 },
		},
		{
			name:      "-10 + A",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("-10 + (%s)", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return -10 + v },
		},
		{
			name:      "A - -5",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("(%s) - -5", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return v - -5 },

		{
			name:      "-5 - A",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("-5 - (%s)", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return -5 - v },
		},
		{
			name:      "A * -2",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("(%s) * -2", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return v * -2 },
		},
		{
			name:      "-2 * A",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("-2 * (%s)", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return -2 * v },
		},
		{
			name:      "A / -2",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("(%s) / -2", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return v / -2 },
		},
		{
			name: "-2 / A",
			q:    fmt.Sprintf("-2 / (%s)", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 {
				if v == 0 {
					return math.NaN()
				}
				return -2 / v
			},
		},

		// negative numbers (float)
		{
			name:      "A + -1.5",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("(%s) + -1.5", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return v + -1.5 },
		},
		{
			name:      "-1.5 + A",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("-1.5 + (%s)", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return -1.5 + v },

		{
			name:      "A - -1.5",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("(%s) - -1.5", q),

		{
			name:      "-1.5 - A",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("-1.5 - (%s)", q),

		},
		{
			name:      "A * -2.5",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("(%s) * -2.5", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return v * -2.5 },

		{
			name:      "-2.5 * A",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("-2.5 * (%s)", q),

		{
			name:      "A / -2.5",

		{
			name: "-2.5 / A",
			q:    fmt.Sprintf("-2.5 / (%s)", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 {
				if v == 0 {
					return math.NaN()
				}
				return -2.5 / v
			},
		},

		// operation order
		{
			name:      "A * 2 + 5",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("(%s) * 2 + 5", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return v*2 + 5 },
		},
		{
			name:      "A * (2 + 5)",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("(%s) * (2 + 5)", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return v * (2 + 5) },
		},
		{
			name:      "5 + A * 2",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("5 + (%s) * 2", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return 5 + v*2 },
		},
		{
			name:      "(A + 5) * 2",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("((%s) + 5) * 2", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return (v + 5) * 2 },
		},
		{
			name:      "A + 5 * 2",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("(%s) + 5 * 2", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return v + 5*2 },
		},
		{
			name:      "A / 2 + 1",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("(%s) / 2 + 1", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return v/2 + 1 },
		},
		{
			name:      "A / (2 + 1)",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("(%s) / (2 + 1)", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return v / (2 + 1) },
		},
		{
			name: "10 / A * 2",
			q:    fmt.Sprintf("10 / (%s) * 2", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 {
				if v == 0 {
					return math.NaN() // 10/0=NaN, NaN*2=NaN
				}
				return 10 / v * 2
			},
		},
		{
			name: "10 / (A * 2)",
			q:    fmt.Sprintf("10 / ((%s) * 2)", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 {
				if v == 0 {
					return math.NaN()
				}
				return 10 / (v * 2)
			},
		},
		{
			name:      "A - 10 - 5",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("(%s) - 10 - 5", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return v - 10 - 5 },
		},
		{
			name:      "A - (10 - 5)",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("(%s) - (10 - 5)", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return v - (10 - 5) },
		},
		{
			name: "100 / A / 2",
			q:    fmt.Sprintf("100 / (%s) / 2", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 {
				if v == 0 {
					return math.NaN() // 100/0=NaN
				}
				return 100 / v / 2
			},
		},
		{
			name: "100 / (A / 2)",
			q:    fmt.Sprintf("100 / ((%s) / 2)", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 {
				if v == 0 {
					return math.NaN()
				}
				return 100 / (v / 2)
			},
		},
		{
			name:      "10 + 5 * A / 2",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("10 + 5 * (%s) / 2", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return 10 + 5*v/2 },
		},
		{
			name:      "(10 + 5) * A / 2",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("(10 + 5) * (%s) / 2", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return (10 + 5) * v / 2 },
		},
		{
			name:      "2 + 10 * A",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("2 + 10 * (%s)", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return 2 + (10 * v) },
		},
		{
			name:      "A + 10 / 2 * 4",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("(%s) + 10 / 2 * 4", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return v + 10.0/2*4 },
		},

		// vector and scalar
		{
			name:      "(A + 10) * (A + 1)",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("((%s) + 10) * ((%s) + 1)", q, q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return (v + 10) * (v + 1) },
		},
		{
			name:      "6 / 2 * (A + A)",
			q:         fmt.Sprintf("6 / 2 * ((%s) + (%s))", q, q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 { return 3 * (v + v) },
		},

		// comparison
		{
			name: "A > 1",
			q:    fmt.Sprintf("(%s) > 1", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 {
				if v > 1 {
					return v
				}
				return math.NaN()
			},
		},
		{
			name: "A > 1.0",
			q:    fmt.Sprintf("(%s) > 1.0", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 {
				if v > 1 {
					return v
				}
				return math.NaN()
			},
		},
		{
			name: "A >= 3",
			q:    fmt.Sprintf("(%s) >= 3", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 {
				if v >= 3 {
					return v
				}
				return math.NaN()
			},
		},
		{
			name: "A >= 3.0",
			q:    fmt.Sprintf("(%s) >= 3.0", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 {
				if v >= 3 {
					return v
				}
				return math.NaN()
			},
		},
		{
			name: "A < 4",
			q:    fmt.Sprintf("(%s) < 4", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 {
				if v < 4 {
					return v
				}
				return math.NaN()
			},
		},
		{
			name: "A <= 4",
			q:    fmt.Sprintf("(%s) <= 4", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 {
				if v <= 4 {
					return v
				}
				return math.NaN()
			},
		},
		{
			name: "A < 4.0",
			q:    fmt.Sprintf("(%s) < 4.0", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 {
				if v < 4 {
					return v
				}
				return math.NaN()
			},
		},
		{
			name: "A <= 4.0",
			q:    fmt.Sprintf("(%s) <= 4.0", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 {
				if v <= 4 {
					return v
				}
				return math.NaN()
			},
		},
		{
			name: "A < 3.5",
			q:    fmt.Sprintf("(%s) < 3.5", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 {
				if v < 3.5 {
					return v
				}
				return math.NaN()
			},
		},
		{
			name: "A == 3",
			q:    fmt.Sprintf("(%s) = 3", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 {
				if v == 3 {
					return v
				}
				return math.NaN()
			},
		},
		{
			name: "A == 3.0",
			q:    fmt.Sprintf("(%s) = 3.0", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 {
				if v == 3 {
					return v
				}
				return math.NaN()
			},
		},
		{
			name: "A != 3",
			q:    fmt.Sprintf("(%s) != 3", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 {
				if v != 3 {
					return v
				}
				return math.NaN()
			},
		},
		{
			name: "A != 3.0",
			q:    fmt.Sprintf("(%s) != 3.0", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 {
				if v != 3 {
					return v
				}
				return math.NaN()
			},
		},

		// comparison order
		{
			name: "A >= 1.5 * 2",
			q:    fmt.Sprintf("(%s) >= 1.5 * 2", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 {
				if v >= 3 {
					return v
				}
				return math.NaN()
			},
		},
		{
			name: "(A >= 1.5) * 2",
			q:    fmt.Sprintf("(%s >= 1.5) * 2", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 {
				if v >= 1.5 {
					return v * 2
				}
				return math.NaN()
			},
		},
		{
			name: "2 * A >= 1.5",
			q:    fmt.Sprintf("2 * (%s) >= 1.5", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 {
				if 2*v >= 1.5 {
					return 2 * v
				}
				return math.NaN()
			},
		},
		{
			name: "2 * (A >= 1.5)",
			q:    fmt.Sprintf("2 * (%s >= 1.5)", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 {
				if v >= 1.5 {
					return 2 * v
				}
				return math.NaN()
			},
		},
		{
			name: "A >= 3 <=4",
			q:    fmt.Sprintf("(%s) >= 3 <= 4", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 {
				if v >= 3 && v <= 4 {
					return v
				}
				return math.NaN()
			},
		},
		{
			name: "A >=3 < 4",
			q:    fmt.Sprintf("(%s) >= 3 < 4", q),
			transform: func(v float64) float64 {
				if v >= 3 && v < 4 {
					return v
				}
				return math.NaN()
			},
		},
	}
}

func storageTable() []storageCase {
	return []storageCase{
		{name: "math_max_over_time_gt_filter", query: "({ } | max_over_time(duration)) + ({ } | max_over_time(duration)) > 60",
			expectedL1: []*series{
				{
					Labels: []label{
						stringLabel("__name__", "max_over_time"),
					},
					Samples: []sample{
						{TimestampMs: 15_000, Value: 15},
						{TimestampMs: 30_000, Value: 30},
						{TimestampMs: 45_000, Value: 45},
						{TimestampMs: 60_000, Value: 50},
					},
				},
			},
			expectedL2: nil,
			expectedL3: []*series{
				{
					Labels: []label{stringLabel("__name__", "(max_over_time + max_over_time)")},
					Samples: []sample{
						{TimestampMs: 45_000, Value: 90},  // 45+45
						{TimestampMs: 60_000, Value: 100}, // 50+50
					},
				},
			},
		},
		{name: "math_rate_plus_rate", query: "({} | rate()) + ({} | rate())",
			expectedL1: []*series{
				{
					Labels: []label{
						stringLabel("__name__", "rate"),
					},
					Samples: []sample{
						{TimestampMs: 15_000, Value: 1.0},
						{TimestampMs: 30_000, Value: 1.0},
						{TimestampMs: 45_000, Value: 1.0},
						{TimestampMs: 60_000, Value: 5.0 / 15.0},
					},
				},
			},
			expectedL2: []*series{
				{
					Labels: []label{
						stringLabel("__name__", "rate"),
					},
					// Two sources: rate is summed, so doubled
					Samples: []sample{
						{TimestampMs: 15_000, Value: 2 * 1.0},
						{TimestampMs: 30_000, Value: 2 * 1.0},
						{TimestampMs: 45_000, Value: 2 * 1.0},
						{TimestampMs: 60_000, Value: 2 * 5.0 / 15.0},
					},
				},

				{
					// L3 applies rate+rate on the L2 accumulated value (2x), giving 4x single-source rate.
					// This is 2x the plain "{ } | rate()" L3 result from two sources.
					Labels: []label{
						stringLabel("__name__", "(rate + rate)"),
					},
					Samples: []sample{
						{TimestampMs: 15_000, Value: 4 * 1.0},
						{TimestampMs: 30_000, Value: 4 * 1.0},
						{TimestampMs: 45_000, Value: 4 * 1.0},
						{TimestampMs: 60_000, Value: 4 * 5.0 / 15.0},
					},
				},

func main() {
	var fixture map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(fixtureMetadata), &fixture); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	scalar := fixture["scalar"].(map[string]any)
	scalarCases := scalar["cases"].([]any)
	table := scalarTable()
	if len(table) != 87 || len(scalarCases) != len(table) {
		panic("scalar count mismatch")
	}
	for i, tc := range table {
		row := scalarCases[i].(map[string]any)
		if row["name"] != tc.name {
			panic("scalar name mismatch")
		}
		row["query"] = tc.q
		expected := map[string]any{}
		for key, values := range map[string][]float64{"bar": {3, 4, 0}, "baz": {1, 0, 3}} {
			out := make([]any, len(values))
			for j, v := range values {
				out[j] = number(tc.transform(v))
			}
			expected[key] = out
		}
		row["expected"] = expected
	}
	storage := fixture["storage"].(map[string]any)
	storageCases := storage["cases"].([]any)
	stored := storageTable()
	if len(stored) != 23 || len(storageCases) != len(stored) {
		panic("storage count mismatch")
	}
	for i, tc := range stored {
		row := storageCases[i].(map[string]any)
		if row["name"] != tc.name || row["query"] != tc.query {
			panic("storage name/query mismatch")
		}
		row["expected_l1"] = tc.expectedL1
		row["expected_l2"] = tc.expectedL2 // null means unchanged from L1, as upstream.
		row["expected_l3"] = tc.expectedL3
	}
	enc := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	enc.SetIndent("", "  ")
	enc.SetEscapeHTML(false)
	if err := enc.Encode(fixture); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
